instruction:
Three Storey Mixed-Use Corner Building IFC

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create a Revit mixed-use corner building with retail at level 1 and office spaces above, then save the required output in the Desktop as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 3 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 6 IfcSpace entities, 18 IfcWall entities, 3 IfcSlab entities, and 1 IfcRoof.
5. The IFC model contains at least 9 IfcDoor entities, at least 17 IfcWindow entities, and at least 3 IfcStair entities.
6. The IFC model contains 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcColumn, and 0 IfcBeam entities.
7. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the token retail at least once, lobby at least once, office at least 2 times, and meeting at least 2 times.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding-box X span is between 18.5 m and 21.5 m.
9. The shaped IFC product bounding-box Y span is between 16.5 m and 19.5 m.
10. The shaped IFC product bounding-box Z span is between 9.8 m and 11.5 m.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
